answer: A single clone pays £60 and 120 hours of verified waiting per clone, and the anchor is that the payout per clone never grows to meet it. The wander is the gap between one honest check and a hundred bought ones — a gap the farm pays for in full. Detection is never the point; the price is. Nothing is paid until Invested vehicle inspector warrant with vehicle inspectors verification is satisfied, and a warrant inspectors confirm after inspection audits makes the orchard a test no script can sit for someone else.
